lede: Tuesday's Town Council meeting is the one to watch this week — council takes up third reading of the Colorado Wildfire Resiliency Code, which would amend Telluride's Land Use Code to change historic and architectural review standards and landscaping and tree rules for property owners across town. Thursday's San Miguel County Planning Commission adds another layer, with a work session on subdivision mechanics and a referral on an energy code update that would revise building standards for new construction. Meanwhile, the Telluride Mushroom Festival kicks off midweek and the Ridgway Rendezvous fills the weekend.

notable.stake: Third reading vote on wildfire code that rewrites LUC landscaping and review rules.
